scope.component: Linux synchronous descriptor custody then runtime checkpoint transport

ownership_and_protocol: Public construction accepts only SO_PEERCRED UID 0 and the caller-pinned PID; expected identity must come from the trusted launcher, not a reply/path/TOFU discovery.
Caller must establish the host PID/user namespace and original Root authority provenance separately. Numeric UID/PID and proc observations are namespace-relative.
Both owned descriptors regain FD_CLOEXEC without dropping other descriptor flags. No raw handle escapes. Other pre-existing aliases are not disproved or revoked.
Original pidfd must identify the pinned PID. Bounded proc reads validate boot ID and process start ticks, then zero-time poll rejects readiness or any error.
Synchronous phase creates no runtime/task/thread or credentials; entered I/O-enabled Tokio is a real second-phase precondition. The runtime API can panic without a reactor as documented by Tokio.
Setting O_NONBLOCK affects the shared socket open-file-description. Launcher aliases expecting blocking I/O are not permitted by this contract.
Exclusive &mut exchange takes the stream before its first await. Cancellation or any in-flight error drops it permanently; no automatic retry/reconnect/path reopen.
Request bytes use the real frozen codec, 4-byte BE length and at most 32KiB response. Returned ACK bytes preserve the actual wire; basic decode/request-ID checks do not grant Current.
Root pidfd readiness and original lifetime deadline bound exchanges; they do not make liveness atomic with future database COMMIT/FinalUse. Any readiness/error/elapsed deadline refuses.
A complete Refused response also invalidates this new lane. No pre-existing denial-reuse contract is changed.

controls: five wrong UID/PID/boot/birth/not-pidfd rejections with owned socket EOF; public UID gate; synchronous custody and CLOEXEC observation
actual framed ACK original bytes; request-ID mismatch permanently closes lane
exchange is polled until real peer receives exact request, then future cancellation causes EOF and unusable lane
peer actually receives exact request and withholds reply; original one-second fixture deadline closes lane
tests.causal_limit: CLOEXEC positive observation begins with ordinary CLOEXEC descriptors; no claim that this test alone proves restoration across exec. The pidfd is the current test process: no independent Root process/death control is claimed.

remain_open: Actual independent UID0 Root/sealed handoff/host namespace provenance and original pidfd transfer; private fixture is not that evidence.
Actual independent Root exit and a late exit/atomic admission window are not covered by the self-pidfd controls.
Current private construction requires authenticated live owner/lease/expiry/revocation/Root authority plus legal phase/exact cut/full predecessor-successor, not arbitrary Receipt.
Whole-owner three-pool coordinator/binder is still absent from the frozen B final state. Existing monotonic gate cannot be replaced by no-op before_checkout or DTO.
Current recovery/bind/writer construction must respect physical connection custody and cannot use donor Arc::strong_count==1 as exclusive ownership proof.
Normal Root producer, listener custody, independent signer/issuer and ordinary Desktop joint Notes/Calculator wiring remain distinct required cohorts; no Root activation or effect acceptance here.
Original generic production attachment/original_sender, ordinary control peer/current-user gates and Windows private-state/retained directory semantics remain unchanged.

SO_PEERCRED records connection/socketpair establishment credentials. A live original pidfd plus proc identity does not prove that the peer descriptor has never subsequently been transferred. The trusted Root producer/custody contract must retain that boundary.

ACK.head.peer_lifetime is not bound by this transport to Root server identity. The future Current/binder must validate it against the original writer/lease-owner semantics; it must not merely compare that owner field to the Root server PID.
